const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "python3 -c 'import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/"tools"))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
manifest=load_manifest(version="tome-1.7.6",manifest_path=None)
runtime=LuaRuntime(manifest); runtime.doctor(); loader=LocaleLoader(runtime)
path=Path("tome-ashes-urhrok.lua")
before=loader.load_bytes(subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:tome-ashes-urhrok.lua"]),logical_path=str(path))

workset=json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w30-20260925/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]

assert len(before.records)==len(after.records)==849
changed=set(); non_target=[]
ignored={"line","target"}
for old,new in zip(before.records,after.records):
    assert old.get("kind")==new.get("kind")
    comparable=set(old)|set(new)
    drift={k:(old.get(k),new.get(k)) for k in comparable-ignored if old.get(k)!=new.get(k)}
    if drift: non_target.append((key(old),drift))
    if old.get("target")!=new.get("target"): changed.add(key(new))

const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "python3 -c 'import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/"tools"))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
manifest=load_manifest(version="tome-1.7.6",manifest_path=None)
runtime=LuaRuntime(manifest); runtime.doctor(); loader=LocaleLoader(runtime)
path=Path("tome-ashes-urhrok.lua")
before=loader.load_bytes(subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:tome-ashes-urhrok.lua"]),logical_path=str(path))
after=loader.load_path(path,logical_path=str(path))
workset=json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w30-20260925/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
def key(row): return (row.get("section"),row.get("source"),row.get("source_tag"))
expected={(x["section"],x["source"],x["source_tag"]) for x in workset}
assert len(expected)==23
assert len(before.records)==len(after.records)
assert len(before.translations)==len(after.translations)==849
changed=set(); non_target=[]
ignored={"line","target"}
for old,new in zip(before.records,after.records):
    assert old.get("kind")==new.get("kind")
    drift={k:(old.get(k),new.get(k)) for k in (set(old)|set(new))-ignored if old.get(k)!=new.get(k)}
    if drift: non_target.append((key(old),drift))
    if old.get("target")!=new.get("target"): changed.add(key(new))
assert not non_target, non_target
assert changed==expected,(len(changed),changed-expected,expected-changed)
target_item=next(x for x in workset if x["entry_revision_identity"].startswith("df5ab19126"))
target_key=(target_item["section"],target_item["source"],target_item["source_tag"])
target=next(x for x in after.translations if key(x)==target_key)
assert target["target"]=="支付 %d%% 当前生命值，1 回合内你造成的所有伤害转化为暗影伤害。\n\t\t\t如果黑暗支配开启，每有一层，你获得 %d 体力与 %d 活力。"
print(json.dumps({"records_before":len(before.records),"records_after":len(after.records),"translations_before":len(before.translations),"translations_after":len(after.translations),"target_changes":len(changed),"non_target_changes":len(non_target),"workset_match":changed==expected,"df5ab191_exact_target":True},ensure_ascii=False))' && python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict && git diff --check -- tome-ashes-urhrok.lua",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 30000,
  max_output_tokens: 30000,
  sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
  justification: "允许我用修正后的计数口径复跑 LuaJIT 对比，并继续 strict lint 与 diff 检查吗？"
});
